title: Rename TempCustomMigrationTableBuffer back to CustomMigrationTableBuffer
summary: A variable name in custom migration mapping is restored from TempCustomMigrationTableBuffer to CustomMigrationTableBuffer to prevent misleading naming and rule violations.
key_points: Variable renamed in AddCustomMigrationMapping page to reflect its actual usage as a handle, not a data buffer
Change eliminates false positives with the AA0237 rule that flags non-temporary variables with Temp prefix
Naming is now consistent with earlier versions and NAV 28.x backport
Purely cosmetic change with no behavioral impact
